SELECT MAX(T1."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS "Max Eligible Free Rate"
FROM "frpm" AS T1
JOIN "schools" AS T2 ON T1."CDSCode" = T2."CDSCode"
WHERE T2."County" = 'Alameda'	----- bird -----	california_schools
1:
SELECT "School Name"
FROM "frpm"
WHERE "School Type" = 'Continuation' AND "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 0
ORDER BY ("Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") ASC
LIMIT 3	----- bird -----	california_schools
